lines.japanese: あ、どーもどーも死神サン──
lines.english: Oh, hello there, Mr. Grim Reaper—

lines.japanese: ──なんつって？　いやいや、違いましたね。アナタ死神じゃなくて、むしろキューピッド様でしたね。
lines.english: —is what I would say. No, no, that wasn't right. You weren't the Grim Reaper. If anything, you were Lord Cupid.

lines.japanese: ハイ、その節はお世話になりました。さすらいのフリーアルバイター、千歳ぬるぬる鷲介っすコンバンワ～。
lines.english: Yes, thanks for everything back then. This is Shuusuke Slippery Chitose, wandering freelance part-timer, saying good evening.

lines.japanese: なんか、アナタとはしばらくお会いしてなかった気もするンすけど、どうでしたっけ？
lines.english: I feel like we haven't met for a while, but how long has it been?

lines.japanese: えーっと、ちょっと待ってくださいね、思いだしますから。最後に会ったのはたしか……
lines.english: Let's see. Just a moment, please. I'll remember. The last time we met was...

lines.japanese: そうそう、細川玉木の三作目『いつだってプリズム』がめでたく出版の運びとなって、とうとう日和子さんが英里子さん相手にガァー言いかえした、あの日ですね。
lines.english: Right, right. The day Tamaki Hosokawa's third book, *Always a Prism*, was happily sent to press, and Hiyoko finally gave Eriko a piece of her mind.

lines.japanese: ってことは、まあ十日ぶりぐらいすか。どーです、そちら調子は。元気？　平和？　青春？
lines.english: So that makes it about ten days. How are things on your end? Healthy? Peaceful? Youthful?

lines.japanese: もちろん俺は元気ですよ、平和ですよ、青春ですよ。お陰さまでね。日々ぬるっと楽しく生きております。そりゃあ、だって……あ、この話聞きたい？
lines.english: Naturally, I'm healthy, peaceful, and youthful. Thanks to you. I slither happily through each day. Of course I do, because... Oh, you want to hear this story?

lines.japanese: ハイ、相変わらずリアクションなし、と。
ン～もお、無理しちゃって。聞きたいくせに、このこのぉ！
lines.english: Oh, come on. Don't pretend. You want to hear it, don't you? Don't you?

lines.japanese: まあ、それじゃあ、不肖ワタクシ千歳鷲介の物語・その後日談をね、ちょろっとお伝えしときましょうか。
lines.english: Well then, perhaps I should give you a brief account of the further adventures of yours truly, Shuusuke Chitose.

lines.japanese: ま、そんな長々語るつもりはないんすけど、ええ、良かったらそのへん適当に座っていただいて……あっ、コーヒーか紅茶でもお出ししましょうか？
lines.english: I don't plan to go on at great length, but if you like, take any seat around here... Oh, may I offer you coffee or tea?

lines.japanese: ははっ！　ありますよ、そのぐらい。大事なお客さんに、そのぐらいの気は利かせなきゃあ……
lines.english: Haha! Of course I've got coffee and tea. Gotta show an honored guest a little hospitality...

lines.japanese: おっと、シュガーは要りません。いまからお話するのは、とびきり甘い恋物語です。くれぐれも心の虫歯にはご注意を。
lines.english: Oh, but you won't need sugar. The love story I'm about to tell you is exceptionally sweet. Please take great care to avoid cavities of the heart.
